subject: prd/maintenance-sweep
statement: The sweep shall complete each invocation as one bounded pass with no resident process, and shall be bindable to the host scheduler through a delegate-only shim.
rationale: the wake-tick pattern; stage 11's "periodic" without a daemon (D-4; F-6)
fit_criterion: process table shows zero sweep processes between runs; the shim passes the repo's shim test conventions (delegate-only, bash-3.2-clean)
